title: Automotive Lubrication Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Automotive Lubrication Technician Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Gain an appreciation of the environment and safety for themselves, others, and our community.

Demonstrate skills that promote personal and social development. Students will engage with professional communities that require adherence to requirements and encourage leadership within these business organizations.
Demonstrate skills and knowledge in the areas of brakes, suspensions, and electrical systems repair and service.

notes: Core Requirements prints 'Complete 18 units' and 'Minimum Units Required: 18'; all four listed courses total 18 units, so the block is read as all required.
The 'A6' printed after the titles of AUTOMECH 73 and AUTOMECH 91 appears to be a designation (e.g., ASE area or GE area) and is not part of the course code.

The description mentions 'entry-level employment at an automotive repair facility' and 'Beginning technicians' at lubrication service centers, dealerships, and independent repair shops; these were not recorded as named careers. A reviewer may wish to check whether 'technicians' should count.
Courses must be completed with a grade of 'C' or better.
Catalog heading reads 'Summer 2026 - Summer 2027 College Catalog', consistent with the 2026-2027 catalog year.
